changelog: Add narrow negative exception penalizing cuts that separate a numeral token from an immediately following scale/unit token (addresses en_us_66, en_us_278, en_us_203, en_us_1050): reduces false high scores where reliable-looking numerals are split from their units.

Penalize cuts where the token immediately after the marker is a causal/subordinating connector (explicitly include 'because', 'causing', 'so', 'therefore', 'hence') especially when left ends a quoted phrase or standalone NP (addresses en_us_360): avoids over-trusting left-side reliability when remainder often modifies/overturns it.

Reduce boosts for cuts that follow a named organization/place when the right side begins with an appositional parenthetical or immediate abbreviation (right token '(' or comma then '(' or '(' + uppercase) (addresses en_us_738, en_us_1000): prevents splitting names from clarifying parentheticals/roles.

Treat repeated-unit patterns (numeral on one side + unit token immediately on the other) as bad splits (addresses en_us_1050): same mechanism as numeral↔unit rule to stop over-trusting repeated unit separations.

Lower scores for cuts that leave an adjectival/participial modifier phrase at the left that syntactically expects a following noun (examples: 'spoken', 'reported', 'estimated', possibly preceded by adverbs like 'most', 'commonly') when the right begins with a common noun (addresses en_us_417): avoids boosting adjectival fragments that lose their noun anchor.

Add a deterministic tie-break bias: when checklist signals produce exact ties, apply a small deterministic penalty to numeral–unit splits and parenthetical/appositive splits so they no longer tie (implements the critique 'tie_fix').

Integrated all new negative exceptions as narrowly-scoped, surface-token–anchored tendencies and preserved existing general high/low tendencies to retain useful prior behavior (merges critique proposals with original rules).
